description:
Custom Carbon Fiber CNC Machining

We machine custom carbon fiber and composite parts to your exact specs, from one-off prototypes to full production runs. Our CNC capabilities handle stock up to 3" thick, so whether you need precision-cut flat plate or complex geometries, we've got the depth and accuracy to deliver.

We work across a wide range of applications, including:

Drone parts — frames, arms, mounting plates, and structural components built for strength-to-weight performance
Custom boat parts — brackets, panels, and hardware engineered to handle marine environments
Flat plate production — precision-cut carbon fiber and composite sheet stock in custom sizes and tolerances
RC hobby parts — chassis plates, mounts, and lightweight components for RC cars, helicopters, and other hobby builds

From small-batch prototyping to large-scale production runs, we scale to fit your project. Send us your drawings or ideas, and we'll machine it right the first time.
